footer.dataNote: Listings are being expanded region by region. The Atlas does not yet include every Croatian winery.

home.metaTitle: Croatian Wine Atlas — wineries, grapes and wine regions of Croatia
home.metaDescription: Discover Croatian wineries on an interactive map: wine tastings, indigenous grapes such as Plavac Mali, Graševina and Malvazija, and the four official wine regions.
home.heroTitle: A World of Wine. One Remarkable Country.
home.heroIntro: From the limestone terraces of Dalmatia to the red earth of Istria and the rolling hills of Slavonia, Croatia's wineries tell the story of more than a hundred grape varieties, island traditions and family cellars.
home.searchPlaceholder: Search wineries, regions, grapes or locations…
home.atlasIntro: Browse producers by official wine region, filter by grape, wine style or visitor experience, and plan your route.
home.regionsIntro: Croatian regulations divide the country's vineyards into four regions, from the Danube to the southern Adriatic.
home.featuredIntro: An editorial selection across all four regions. Featured listings are chosen by editors and are never paid; sponsored listings are always labelled.
home.grapesIntro: Croatia is home to dozens of indigenous varieties. Start with the grapes that define its regions.
home.experiencesIntro: Tastings, cellar visits and hospitality listed by wineries or documented by cited sources.
home.experiencesEmpty: Experience listings are being added. Contact wineries directly to arrange a visit.
home.storiesIntro: Regions, terroir, grape varieties and the people behind Croatian wine.
home.finalIntro: Pick wineries on the map, add them to a route and share your itinerary.
home.coverageNote: {count} wineries listed so far across four regions — and growing.

regions.metaDescription: The four official wine regions of Croatia — Dalmatia, Istria & Kvarner, Slavonia & the Danube and the Central Uplands — with subregions, grapes and wineries.
regions.title: Wine regions of Croatia
regions.intro: Croatian regulations divide the country's vineyards into four regions and twelve subregions, further divided into wine-growing districts (vinogorja) and vineyard sites.
regions.hierarchy: Region → subregion → wine district (vinogorje) → vineyard site (položaj). Protected designations of origin are a separate legal layer.
regions.districtNote: District list being completed against the official annex.
regions.noDistricts: No wine districts have been added for this subregion yet.
regions.boundaryNote: Official boundary geometry has not been imported yet; the map shows the wineries assigned to this area.

grapes.metaDescription: Encyclopedia of Croatian grape varieties: Plavac Mali, Graševina, Malvazija Istarska, Pošip, Teran, Babić, Grk and more — with regions, wines and producers.
grapes.title: Grape varieties
grapes.intro: From Plavac Mali to Škrlet: the indigenous and traditional grapes of Croatia, with the wineries and wines that express them.

awards.metaDescription: Verified international and national awards won by Croatian wines, linked to the exact wine and vintage.
awards.title: Wine awards
awards.intro: A database of verified awards for Croatian wines. Each record is matched to the exact wine and vintage in the competition's official results.
awards.empty: No verified awards have been published yet.
awards.emptyBody: Award records are added only after an editor matches them to official competition results. Winery owners can submit documentation through the winery portal.
awards.policy: We do not list a winery as award-winning based on its own description. Every award is tied to one wine and vintage, with an official source.

experiences.title: Wine experiences
experiences.intro: Tastings, cellar visits and hospitality at Croatian wineries. Prices and details appear only when the winery or a cited source provides them.

routes.metaDescription: Plan a wine route through Croatia: pick wineries on the map, order your stops and share your itinerary.
routes.title: Wine routes
routes.intro: Curated itineraries through Croatia's wine country, and a planner to build your own.
routes.plannerIntro: Add wineries from the map or any winery profile, reorder your stops and share the route.
routes.emptyRoute: Your route is empty. Add wineries from the map or a winery profile.

routes.orderNote: Lines connect stops in order and are not driving directions.
routes.approximateNote: Some stops use approximate locations. Confirm addresses with each winery.
routes.visitNote: Always arrange visits with each winery in advance.

coverage.metaTitle: Coverage — how many wineries are listed
coverage.title: Coverage
coverage.intro: The Atlas is being built region by region. This page shows exactly what is listed today. It does not claim to include every Croatian winery.
coverage.help: Know a winery that is missing? Wineries can request a listing; anyone can suggest one through the contact page.

claim.title: Claim your winery
claim.intro: Winery owners and managers can claim their listing to update information, add wines and receive tasting requests. Every claim is reviewed by an editor.
claim.listIntro: Not yet in the Atlas? Tell us about your winery. Listings are free; editors review every request before publication.
claim.name: Your full name
claim.emailHint: Ideally an address on the winery's own domain — it speeds up verification.
claim.evidence: How can we verify your connection to the winery?
claim.evidenceHint: For example: listed as owner on the winery website, registration in the wine producers register (OIB / registration number), or an email from the address published on the winery's website.
claim.success: Thank you. An editor will review your request and contact you. You will be able to manage the listing once approved.
claim.error: Your request could not be sent. Please try again.
claim.signInNote: Signing in first links the approved listing directly to your account.
claim.security: We never transfer a listing based on a name alone. Editors verify every claim.
